what_it_does: Large cloud data centers mix different processor types—x86 (Intel/AMD) and ARM—in the same cluster. Memory (DRAM) failures are a major cause of server downtime, but current failure prediction methods treat all servers the same. This paper shows that x86 and ARM platforms have distinct memory failure patterns because they experience different temperature, voltage, and usage stresses. MemSeer analyzes these architecture-specific patterns and uses multi-scale prediction (making predictions at different time horizons simultaneously) to anticipate failures. When integrated into AIOps (automated operations systems), MemSeer improves failure prediction recall by 27% and achieves 17.3% better F1-score (a combined measure of accuracy and completeness) compared to existing methods.
